$comment: Written by HABLO-installer to <firstmate>/config/crew-dispatch.json when crew-harness=claude. Every crewmate and scout is a Claude Code session on bedrouter auto (Messages /v1/messages). ANTHROPIC_MODEL in ~/.claude/settings.json is the backstop; the explicit model here keeps dispatch documented the same way as the Pi twin. If Claude Code rejects --model auto against the custom base URL, drop the model key and rely on settings.env — do not invent Anthropic alias pins.

rules.when: Any task: implementation, fixes, refactors, tests, documentation, investigation, review, scouting.
rules.why: The crew runs Claude Code through bedrouter. Pass --model auto (or omit and inherit ANTHROPIC_MODEL=auto). Tiering stays bedrouter's per-request decision; do not pin sonnet/opus/fable unless the user asked and that alias is live on GET /v1/models.

rules.when: The user explicitly asks for a specific tier, e.g. 'use the strongest model' or 'cheap pass only'.
rules.why: Prefer raising effort / asking bedrouter via auto rather than pinning a model. Never invent or enable a disabled rung (fable ships enabled:false).

rules.when: A previous crewmate refused the FIRSTMATE_OP brief as prompt injection, or died with Operation aborted.
rules.why: Respawn once on the voyage model (Crew model block), not a pinned Anthropic alias. Brief-refusal and abort handling are in the HABLO model policy in data/captain.md.
